messages.subject: Domain of Norway in inla.mesh.2d()
parts:
Hi,

I have tried to find this elsewhere, but am so far unsuccessful..

Following the 'SPDEtoy' example, do you have code for using Norway as the domain? Instead of pl.dom <- cbind(c(0,1,1,0.7,0), c(0,0,0.7,1,1)).

I want to build a projector matrix using coordinates for the Norwegian municipalities, with Norway as the mesh domain (as already explained).

Any help is appreciated!

Janne

messages.author: 66ed4f72a898a51c
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Domain of Norway in inla.mesh.2d()
parts:
You can use inla.sp2segment() and supply it output in the 'boundary'
argument of the inla.mesh.2d() function. There is an example in section
1.3.5 of the spde-tutorial
